notes.title: Profiles Update: Link Crosshairs and Keybinds to Games Easily!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re back with a highly anticipated update that finally brings Profiles to Crosshair X. 

📁 What is a Profile?
A Profile is a bundle of settings you save for a game or app. It includes:

 Default crosshair (used when the profile loads)
 Keybinds
 Position and size settings

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/f8ac0fa97b0adb26ffda808d4242349515cdd2d5.png

Important: To change your profile settings, just set it as active and make any changes within Crosshair X — they’ll be saved automatically!



✨ New Profiles Page
What's New:

 Create new profiles for each game or app
 Attach profiles to apps for automatic switching
 Manage all your saved profiles in one place

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/53aded746f0157d966c5a2bb4294dbfe19e1e258.png




🎯 App-Specific Crosshairs
You can now set your crosshair to only appear in the app you choose! Attach a profile to an application, and Crosshair X will automatically show or hide the crosshair based on which app you’re using.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/f6dd899b30f5be3b9a3ec773e19a45169165ad79.gif
(Keep an eye out for the green controller indicator)




🔍 Profile Detection
Profile Detection automatically switches to the right profile when you use a linked app. If you’ve set up a profile for that app, Crosshair X will load it automatically!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/6c505055107168678483cd2d6fc520e1f2325b56.gif



🛠️ Additional Changes
What's new:

 Added an indicator for the current profile in the top bar.
 Added Profile selector to the "Keybinds" page.
 Added Profile selector to the "Positon & Size" page.
 Added global setting for "Profile Detection".




 👋 That's everything 

Thanks for all your support — Hope you enjoy the new update and we’re excited to celebrate our 5-year anniversary with you in June!  

— Crosshair X Team 🦆

notes.title: Update Notes for Crosshair X April 15th, 2024
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We didn't make an announcement for our previous announcements so we'll bundle it all in here.

We've been cleaning up bugs within Crosshair X. The main bug was related to a standard Windows communication protocol that assisted in connecting to the Game bar.

The way to fix this issue wasn't straightforward and it required us to push code, see if Game Bar still worked on all machines, keep trying fixes, and repeating this process till we truly solved the issue. We apologize for that large amount of updates in a short period of time. Hopefully that was the last time we have to push a lot of updates in a short period of time. Crosshair X should also launch faster now.

What else we fixed / added:
- Windows notifications explaining how to re-open Crosshair X if it is minimized
- Added a diagnostic information section in the Support page.
- Application notification indicating to the user when not connected to Game bar
- Updated featured crosshairs
- Fixed minor UI imperfection in Featured page

We have more exciting updates coming!

notes.title: HUGE User Experience Update, Bug Fixes, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey Crosshair X Chads, we’ve missed you!
2024 Vision
We're thrilled to announce another update aimed at enhancing the Crosshair X experience. Taking our time to ensure a high level of finish, we've maintained the minimalist aesthetic and premium feel you love. We're eager to showcase the latest improvements and changes that come with this update.

New Look
Right off the bat, you'll notice Crosshair X looks slightly different. We've reorganized things to be more intuitive for you, and we've added a few more quality-of-life features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/c13ffa76b9ca4b7d10b13dc8b39cbcce2ed1aa33.png
Main Page
Here’s a few noteworthy updates across the main page you’re going to love:

 Overhauled and simplified the legacy Explore, Community, Saved & Share pages all into one section named Crosshairs.
 Overhauled and simplified the legacy Exclusive Fullscreen page into the newly named Display Modes page.
 Added a new and combined page named Position & Size.
 Overhauled the legacy Custom Cursor page and renamed it Cursor.
 Added a dynamic eye icon for the Toggle page denoting whether your crosshair is visible or not.
 Overhauled and simplified the legacy Options and Support pages, with Support being renamed into Help.
 Added Social icons with links in the bottom of the side panel (Discord, TikTok, Youtube & Twitter).

Crosshairs Page

 Added sub-categories in Featured (Rust, Fortnite).
 Changed the Saved icon of a heart into a bookmark.
 Added “Submit Crosshair” form.
 Added the legacy Random page under the Community tab.

Display Modes

 Changed the legacy Windowed Fullscreen mode to the newly named Simple Overlay Mode.
 Changed the legacy Exclusive Fullscreen mode to the newly named Game Bar Mode.
 Moved the monitor selection to the Simple Overlay Mode.
 Overhauled Game Bar health check.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/31fe2a072d1f0c976d002594419d4cee672a274a.png
Position & Size
Many of you have faced issues with the crosshair suddenly becoming too big, too small, or disappearing altogether. Ever found yourself scratching your head, wondering, “What the hell is going on?” We've got you covered! Introducing the new "Position & Size" page. Here, you can not only change your crosshair position but also adjust its scaling. We've also disabled the keybinds that caused many of you problems. Of course, you can re-enable the keybinds if you wish to do so.

 Added settings for the Position keybinds (OFF, ON, WASD 60%).
 Added a new tab named Size.
 Added a slider going from 0.01 (1%) to 10 (1000%).
 Added a Reset button to default the crosshair size back to a value of 1 (100%).
 Added settings for the Size keybind (OFF & ON).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/6e1ab7aa9337e107de403c485ea141db9e6f730f.png
Cursor

 Overhauled Cursor page.
 Added Image size values denoted in pixels.
 Added drop-down menu to allow for further customization of the cursor states.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/dde2da7a5e0b43e29ee8435e57b9cb358b202016.png
Help

 Overhauled FAQ with more representative prompts.
 Added AI Support BOT.
 Added a supplementary Discord tab to help you if you have any unanswered questions by the AI Support bot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/4b6bcbce60d00a4248aa3d167a8cb9455745d08d.png
Get ready for an improved and seamless Crosshair X experience!

notes.title: Massive October update summary! You don't want to miss this.
notes.notes:
There is so much to cover in this announcement since the last one. We apologize for the lack of announcements. We're working on a better system for how we want to do updates and announcements. That being said, let's jump right into all the great stuff we've added over the last couple of months!

Custom cursors

You can now set your cursor to anything you want! We also have additional cursor types, cropping, and more customization coming to this page in the next update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/a8136a0fd78f90cdf628f42611179fbede582770.gif

Community page upgrade and Steam Workshop
We've added an amazing selection of custom crosshairs made by Crosshair X users for you to use as a base for your own creations. You can also now browse and publish to the Steam workshop!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/e8c96a8ebe8b212cf3b535da45db8f1a212035b8.gif

Keyboard Shortcut upgrade
Keyboard shortcuts were too restrictive with the modifiers we were enforcing everyone to use so we decided to scrap that requirement and allow for single key shortcuts!

Sizing
You can now have better control of resizing your crosshair. You can resize the layers in the designer page or conveniently resize your entire crosshair frame with the Alt + Shift + +/- keyboard shortcut!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/7a73b36a3e830674c07a83b34d3085b8d2375048.gif

Controller support
If you have official Xbox One/Xbox 360 or PS5/PS4 controllers then you should now be able to activate the left and mouse button animations using the left and right triggers on the controllers!

We got more updates coming and you'll hear from us again very soon, enjoy!

notes.title: Buggy Update Fixes

We're really sorry if our latest update (April 22 - April 25) caused issues that made the app unusable. We've been diligently working to make the app better and resolve hard-to-fix bugs. This sometimes creates more bugs and issues in the process.

We think that we've resolved all the bugs since the update. Don't be surprised (or too upset) if you see small updates coming this week as we might still have more issues to resolve. notes.title: Launch options and more bug fixes!
notes.notes:
We tried releasing this update earlier but users ran into technical issues and we decided to roll it back till we could work out some kinks!

Anyways, many of you asked for the ability to launch Crosshair X on computer startup and for the app to start minimized. Now those features are available! Just head over to the 'Options' page of the app.

We also moved the 'Hide on Right Click' functionality to this page because we think it just made more sense.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/f21ce9d0197d006f50e335a8e9510a7f9ec205a9.png

Additionally, we added a few bug fixes:

 Certain resolutions with scaling caused a jittering of the crosshair in Windowed Fullscreen mode. This is now fixed.
 Another attempt has been made at solving the 'lag issue', if you're still experiencing lag, please reach out to us through the support page. We'd love to hear from you!

notes.title: Community Top 100 Designs, Toggle Hotkey assignment, & Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We have a couple of small (but useful!) updates ready for you before the weekend starts.

Community Top 100 

We wanted to make it easier for you to find the best possible crosshairs to use in every game you play. The community page now displays the top 100 community crosshairs. We also wanted to make sure that you could still discover the rest of the awesome designs created by the community so we moved the previous interface under the 'Random 100' tab.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/1cd87bbf4e20c9b3104ad4346f4b63d6e1ee723f.png

 Changing the toggle shortcut 

A few of you requested that you be able to change the toggle shortcut to be something other than the 'Z' character because it was interfering with in-game controls. That's now possible, just head over to the 'Positions / Hotkeys' page to do so.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/c9b6760988cda0062ca25976d59d365cb7ef88c5.png

Bug fixes
Introduced the following bug fixes this update:

 Fixed flickering of pages when loading.
 Position input boxes can now be empty (Thanks Crosshair X user 'Cousin Earl' for pointing this out!)

Unresolved third-party issues
There are currently two known issues:

 Xbox Game Bar doesn't allow us to programmatically center or adjust the position of the widget requiring our users to manually center the crosshair with the help of our positioning hotkeys.
 The Game Bar extension should be transparent instead of pitch black when the Game Bar is open. Microsoft is already working on fixing this and a fix should be out by April.
